question: If a strong AI only needs to guide cheaper ones, how should we decide when the best is really needed?
reflection: When good tools cost less, more schools, clinics and small teams can use them, which spreads opportunity further.

sources.subject: Anthropic cuts frontier AI costs in half without sacrificing performance

one_line: Anthropic showed how a top model can direct cheaper ones to get most of the quality at roughly half the cost, and Claude's background tasks moved to phone and web.

top_stories.title: Use the top model as an advisor, not a worker
top_stories.what: Anthropic described two patterns: a cheaper model does the work and asks the top model for advice, or the top model plans and cheaper models carry out the pieces; it reports up to 96% of top quality at 46% of the cost on research tasks.
top_stories.why: Splitting work by difficulty is a practical way to keep AI budgets under control on large research or document projects.

top_stories.title: Claude tasks keep running after you close the laptop
top_stories.what: Anthropic says Claude Cowork now runs on web and mobile, so tasks continue in the background, scheduled jobs run overnight and the user is asked on their phone when a decision is needed.
top_stories.why: Background agents change how knowledge work is organised and raise new questions about oversight and working hours.

top_stories.title: Free Claude access for open-source maintainers
top_stories.what: Anthropic offers six months of its top paid plan to maintainers of widely used open-source projects.
top_stories.why: Support for open-source maintainers strengthens the shared software many public services rely on.

top_stories.title: Google releases Gemma 4 open models
top_stories.what: Google released Gemma 4, a family of open-weight models from 2B to 31B parameters with built-in reasoning.
top_stories.why: Small open models with reasoning can run on local servers, which helps where data must stay on site.

saudi_lens.text: Lower running costs for strong AI help Saudi public bodies and small firms scale pilots without large cloud bills, while open models like Gemma can be hosted inside the Kingdom.

idea.title: Two-tier AI for document review
idea.pitch: Use a cheaper model to sort and summarise large document sets and send only the hard cases to a top model, with cost tracked per document.
idea.first_step: Pick 50 past documents, run them through a cheap model and note which ones a human says needed a stronger review.

idea_kids.title: Team captain and helpers
idea_kids.pitch: A classroom game where one child plans a group task, such as building a paper bridge, and helpers each build one part, then the team talks about how planning and doing were shared.
idea_kids.first_step: Gather paper, tape and books, and write a one-page plan sheet for the captain.

terms.definition: A helper AI agent that a main agent hands a smaller piece of work to.
What it costs in AI usage fees to complete one piece of work, a fairer measure than price per word.

concepts.summary: A strong model plans or advises while cheaper models do most of the work.
Agent tasks that continue in the background across devices.
Near-top quality at about half the price through smarter task splitting.
